name: Party Rock
summary: Visually, the aesthetic is characterized by a clash of " Hipster " irony and " Rave " excess, featuring animal prints, neon spandex, lensless glasses, and the popularization of the "Melbourne Shuffle" dance.
description: Visually, the aesthetic is characterized by a clash of " Hipster " irony and " Rave " excess, featuring animal prints, neon spandex, lensless glasses, and the popularization of the "Melbourne Shuffle" dance. While closely related to Recession Pop (the musical genre) and Swag (the urban fashion trend), Party Rock is distinct for its specific focus on "forced fun," goofiness, and a visual aesthetic centered around "shuffling" and house party chaos rather than coolness or wealth.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Hedonism, irony, unapologetic fun ("Sorry For Party Rocking"), excess, dance

visualDNA.colour: Neon pink, electric blue, highlighter yellow, gold, zebra (black/white)

fashion.Overview: The Party Rock look was characterized by its lack of subtlety and its embrace of "tacky" patterns. The fashion was a commercialized mutation of the Scene and Indie Sleaze / New Rave trends that came before it, stripping away the angst and replacing it with neon joy. The most iconic accessory of the era was the pair of Shutter Shades or, alternatively, thick-rimmed "nerd" glasses with the lenses popped out. This " geek chic " element was often paired with deep V-neck t-shirts, skinny jeans (often in bright primary colors like red or electric blue), and high-top sneakers.
